Definition: from G5343; a fleeing, i.e. escape:--flight.
BiblicalUsage: Phyge is flight, running for your life. Jesus tells His disciples to pray their flight in the days of distress is not in winter or on the Sabbath, in Matthew 24:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God hears prayers about the smallest details of escape, even the season and the day.
